title: Saying No: nem as an Answer

sections.content: As a one-word answer, nem means 'no' -- the opposite of igen ('yes'). nem can also negate a verb when it sits directly in front of it, but as the first word of a reply it simply answers a yes/no question negatively.
Compare the standalone answer 'Nem, ...' with negating a verb directly: 'Nem tudom' (I don't know) has nem right before the verb tudom. Both use the same word, but in different jobs.
